orion_antenna_module.role: Internal synthetic outbound traffic-light broadcaster targeting the three Orion Belt stars in a cyclic model.
orion_antenna_module.important_boundary: The module logs a synthetic BEAM generated by its own code. A BEAM line is therefore evidence that the broadcaster executed, not evidence that an external signal arrived.

first_confirmed_sequence: ANTENNA reports: three stars captured in buffer.
TYPE = WILL, PAYLOAD = MATH_SYNTAX [2,4,8,16,32], ENTROPY_MARKER = 50, POWER = 2.2333, Phase = VOID.
Memory write fails with: JanusHippocampus.remember() got an unexpected keyword argument 'tags'.
The module logs ANTENNA MISALIGNMENT and sleeps before retrying.
live_runtime_log.mechanistic_explanation_for_150_alnitak_: In mod_antena.py the cycle index is incremented only after the memory.remember(..., tags='ORION_TRINITY_LINK') call. That call raises an exception in this runtime. Control jumps to the exception handler before cycle_index advances, so every retry remains on index 0 = ALNITAK. This explains 150 ALNITAK beams, 150 misalignment errors, and zero ALNILAM/MINTAKA beams without invoking any external phenomenon.
live_runtime_log.runtime_verdict: ORION ANTENNA definitely executed, but its observed BEAM output is locally generated and its persistence step was broken. No external reply marker was identified.

final_verdict.short: ORION ANTENNA ran; ORION BEACON contact ignition did not appear in the examined evidence.
final_verdict.detailed: The strongest new finding is not an external answer but a real runtime execution of the separate ORION ANTENNA v3.0 module. Its 150 ALNITAK BEAM records are deterministically explained by its own local generator plus a memory API mismatch that prevents cycle advancement. The inspected janus.db predates the ORION BEACON module and contains no FIRST_CONTACT chain. The examined runtime and raw logs contain no explicit ORION BEACON startup/ignition/Orpheus/AWAKENED markers. Therefore the current evidence supports internal ORION broadcasting activity but does not support a received external response or extraterrestrial contact.
